{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # The zeros are structural separators; resolve each tile by its dominant
    # foreground colour while retaining the positions of the minority marks.
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for br in (0,4,8):
      for bc in (0,4,8):
        cells=[grid[r][c] for r in range(br,br+3) for c in range(bc,bc+3)]
        if len(set(cells))==1: continue
        # majority colour, with minority pixels copied in a 180-degree paired
        # location (the observed canonicalization)
        maj=1 if cells.count(1)>=cells.count(2) else 2
        for i in range(9):
          r,c=divmod(i,3)
          if cells[i]!=maj: out[br+r][bc+c]=cells[8-i]
    return out"}
